verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              प्रकाशिते तदा लोके रजसा तमसावृते। समाजग्मुरथो वीराः परस्परवधैषिणः॥१॥
ते समेत्य रणे राजन् शस्त्रप्रासासिधारिणः। परस्परमुदैक्षन्त परस्परकृतागसः॥२॥
verses.english: Taking up their lances, swords and (other) weapons and encountering one another, they looked wrathfully at one another in battle, o king.

verses.sanskrit: प्रदीपानां सहस्रैश्च दीप्यमानैः समंततः।  रत्नाचितैः स्वर्णदण्डैर्गन्धतैलावसिञ्चितैः॥३॥
verses.english: With thousands of lamps shedding their lustre all around and placed upon golden steeds adorned with gems and fed with fragrant oil.

verses.sanskrit: देवगन्धर्वदीपाद्यैः प्रभाभिरधिकोज्ज्वलैः।  विरराज तदा भूमिर्ग्रहैर्द्यौरिव भारत॥४॥
उल्काशतैः प्रज्वलितै रणभूमिर्व्यराजत।  दह्यमानेव लोकानामभावे च वसुन्धरा॥५॥
व्यदीप्यन्त दिशः सर्वाः प्रदीपैस्तैः समंततः।  वर्षाप्रदोषे खद्योतैर्वृता वृक्षा इवाबभुः॥६॥
verses.english: All the points illuminated by the light of) those lamps all around, looked (beautiful) like trees teeming with glow-worms on an evening of the rainy season.

verses.sanskrit: असज्जन्त ततो वीरा वीरेष्वेव पृथक् पृथक्।  नागा नागैः समाजग्मुस्तुरगा हयसादिभिः।  रथा रथवरैरेव समाजग्मुर्मुदा युताः। तस्मिन् रात्रिमुखे घोरे तव पुत्रस्य शासनात्॥८॥
verses.english: and car-warriors joyfully engaged with one another, during the dreadful night at the command of your son.

verses.sanskrit: चतुरङ्गस्य सैन्यस्य संपातश्च महानभूत्।  ततोऽर्जुनो महाराज कौरवाणामनीकिनीम्॥९॥
verses.english: Terrific, (indeed) was the clash of the two armies, (each) consisting of four (kinds of) forces. Then, 0 great king, Arjuna, vanquishing all the kings (on your son's side), began quickly to destroy the army of the Kauravas.

verses.sanskrit:
व्यधमत्त्वरया युक्तः क्षपयन्सर्वपार्थिवान्।
              धृतराष्ट्र उवाच।
              तस्मिन्प्रविष्टे संरब्धे मम पुत्रस्य वाहिनीम्॥१०॥
अमृष्यमाणे दुर्धर्षे कथमासीन्मनो हि वः।  किमकुर्वत सैन्यानि प्रविष्टे परपीडने॥११॥
verses.english: Dhritarastra said What, (O Sanjaya) became the state of your minds when, filled with rage, the invincible one (i.e. Arjuna) entered into my son's army?

verses.sanskrit: दुर्योधनश्च किं कृत्यं प्राप्तकालममन्यत।  के चैनं समरे वीरं प्रत्युद्ययुररिन्दमाः॥१२॥
verses.english: What did (my) forces do then when that sorcher of foes penetrated into them? (And) what course, (best) suited to that occasion, did Duryodhana think to adopt?

verses.sanskrit: द्रोणं च के व्यरक्षन्त प्रविष्टे श्वेतवाहने।  केऽरक्षन्दक्षिणं चक्रं के च द्रोणस्य सव्यतः॥१३॥
verses.english: What chastisers of foes opposed (the career of) that hero? Who were they that protected Drona when Shetavahana entered into our army)?

verses.sanskrit: के पृष्ठतश्चाप्यभवन्वीरा वीरान्विनिघ्नतः।  के पुरस्तादङ्गच्छन्त निघ्नन्तः शात्रवान् रणे॥१४॥
verses.english: Who were they that protected the right and the left car-wheels of Drona? Who were those heroes that protected the rear of that hero when he was engaged in fighting?

verses.sanskrit: यत्प्राविशन्महेष्वासः पञ्चालानपराजितः।  नृत्यन्निव नरव्याघ्रो रथमार्गेषु वीर्यवान्॥१५॥
verses.english: Indeed, when that invincible, puissant and mighty bowman, endued with the valour of a tiger, penetrated into the midst of the Panchalas, dancing as it were along the track of his car and destroying his enemies in battle, who were they that came to his front? How did Drona who consumed large troops of cars of the Panchalas.

verses.sanskrit: यो ददाह शरैर्द्रोणः पञ्चालानां रथव्रजान्।  धूमकेतुरिव क्रुद्धः कथं मृत्युमुपेयिवान्॥१६॥
अव्यग्रानेव हि परान्कथयस्यपराजितान्। हृष्टानुदीर्णान्संग्रामे न तथा सूत मामकान्॥१७॥
verses.english: Like a wrathful meteor, meet with his death? You always describe my enemies as cool, unvanquished.

verses.sanskrit: हतांश्चैव विदीर्णांश्च विप्रकीर्णांश्च शंससि।  रथिनो विरथांश्चैव कृतान् युद्धेषु मामकान्॥१८॥
verses.english: Cheerful and impetuous in battle. But, O Sanjaya, you do not speak so of my warriors. You speak of them as slain, pale and routed and of my car-warriors as (always) made carless in the battle?

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              द्रोणस्य मतमाज्ञाय योद्धकामस्य तां निशांम्।  दुर्योधनो महाराज वश्यान् भ्रातॄनुवाच ह॥१९॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said Aware of the intentions of Drona as desirous of fighting during that night, Duryodhana, O mighty monarch, addressed his obedient brothers.

verses.sanskrit: कर्णं च वृषसेनं च मद्रराजं च कौरव।  दुर्धर्षं दीर्घबाहुं च ये च तेषां पदानुगाः॥२०॥
verses.english: (Namely) Vikarna, Chitrasena, Suparsa, Durdharsha and Dirghabahu and all their followers sayingद्रोणं यत्ताः परक्रान्ताः सर्वे रक्षन्तु पृष्ठतः।

verses.sanskrit: द्रोणं यत्ताः पराक्रान्ताः सर्वे रक्षन्तु पृष्ठतः।  हार्दिक्यो दक्षिणं चक्रं शल्यश्चैवोत्तरं तथा॥२१॥
त्रिगर्तानां च ये शूरा हतशिष्टा महारथाः।  तांश्चैव पुरतः सर्वान्पुत्रस्ते समचोदयत्॥२२॥
verses.english: Then your son commanded all the survivors of the heroic Trigarta warriors to place themselves in the van (saying).

verses.sanskrit: आचार्यो हि सुसंयत्तो भृशं यत्ताश्च पांडवाः।  तं रक्षत सुसंयत्ता निघ्नन्तं शात्रवान् रणे॥२३॥
द्रोणो हि बलवान् युद्धे क्षिप्रहस्तः प्रतापवान्।  निर्जयेत्त्रिदशान् युद्धे किमु पार्थान्ससोमकान्॥२४॥
verses.english: Drona is powerful in battle, is endued with nimbleness of hand and is puissant. Not to speak of Pandavas united with the Somakas, he is competent to vanquish even the very gods in battle.

verses.sanskrit: ते यूयं सहिताः सर्वे भृशं यत्ता महारथाः।  द्रोणं रक्षत पाञ्चालाद्धृष्टद्युम्नान्महारथात्॥२५॥
verses.english: United together and exerting your very best in (this) dreadful engagement, all of you protect Drona from that invincible and mighty car-warrior Dhristadyumna.

verses.sanskrit: पाण्डवीयेषु सैन्येषु न तं पश्याम कञ्चन।  यो योधयेद्रणे द्रोणं धृष्टद्युम्नादृते नृपः॥२६॥
verses.english: I do not find any one among the warriors of the Pandavas except Dhristadyumna, that is capable of defeating Drona in battle.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्सर्वात्मना मन्ये भारद्वाजस्य रक्षणम्।  सुगुप्तः पाण्डवान् हन्यात् सृञ्जयांश्च ससोमकान्॥२७॥
verses.english: I therefore think we should apply our whole heart and soul to protection of the son of Bharadvaja. (If) protected (by us) he will gradually destroy the Somakas as well as the Srinjayas.

verses.sanskrit: सृञ्जयेष्वथ सर्वेषु निहतेषु चमूमुखे।  धृष्टद्युम्नं रणे द्रौणिर्हनिष्यति न संशयः॥२८॥
verses.english: When all the Srinjayas, (placed) in the van of the (Pandava) army will be destroyed, the son of Drona will undoubtedly slay Dhristadyumna in battle.

verses.sanskrit: तथाऽर्जुनं च राधेयो हनिष्यति महारथः।  भीमसेनमहं चापि युद्धे जेष्याभि दीक्षितः॥२९॥
verses.english: Similarly the great car-warrior Karna will vanquish Arjuna in battle. (And) I will myself destroy Bhimasena and others clad in mail in battle.

verses.sanskrit: शेषांश्च पाण्डवान् योधाः प्रसभं हीनतेजसः।  सोऽयं मम जयो व्यक्तो दीर्घकालं भविष्यति॥३०॥
verses.english: The remaining Pandavas, destitute of energy, will be easily subjugated by (my) warriors. My success, then, will last for a long time.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्रक्षत संग्रामे द्रोणमेव महारथम्। इत्युक्त्वा भरतश्रेष्ठ पुत्रो दुर्योधनस्तव॥३१॥
verses.english: Therefore protect (carefully) the mighty car-warrior Drona in battle." Thus addressing (his soldiers), your son Duryodhana, 0 foremost of the descendants of Bharata.

verses.sanskrit: व्यादिदेश तथा सैन्यं तस्मिंस्तमसि दारुणे।  ततः प्रववृते युद्धं रात्रौ भरतसत्तम॥३२॥
verses.english: Then cominanded his army (to act in obedience to his orders) during that dreadfully dark night. Then, O most exalted of Bharatas, took place a battle.

verses.sanskrit: उभयोः सेनयोर्घोरं परस्परजिगीषया।  अर्जुनः कौरवं सैन्यमर्जुनं चापि कौरवाः॥३३॥
नानाशस्त्रसमावायैरन्योन्यं समपीडयन्।  द्रौणिः पाञ्चालराजं च भारद्वाजश्च सृञ्जयान्॥३४॥
verses.english: Between the two armies, both desirous of victory, O king, Arjuna, (then), began to sorely assailed the army of the Kauravas and Arjuna, with numerous (sorts of) weapons. (And) in that engagement the son of Drona began to cover the Panchala king and the son of Bharadvaja, the Srinjayas, with straight arrows. (And) O Bharata, as the armies of the Pandavas and the Panchalas (on one side) and that of the Kauravas (on the other).

verses.sanskrit: छादयांचक्रिरे संख्ये शरैः सन्नतपर्वभिः।  पाण्डुपाञ्चालसैन्यानां कौरवाणां च भारत॥३५॥
आसीन्निष्टानको घोरो निघ्नतामितरेतरम्।  नैवास्माभिस्तथा पूर्वैर्दृष्टपूर्वं तथाविधम्॥३६॥
श्रुतं वा यादृशं युद्धमासीद्रौद्रं भयानकम्॥३७॥
verses.english: Fell to destroying one another there arose a dreadful uproar. Neither ourselves nor those who preceded us, had (previously) witnessed such a furious and dreadful battle as took place during that night.
